articles.title: Trump promised to slash energy costs — but gasoline, diesel and jet fuel all soared instead
articles.summary: President Donald Trump promised voters angry about inflation that he would slash gas prices below $2 a gallon within his first year in office. "My plan will cut energy prices in half or more than that within 12 months of taking office," Trump said in a speech to the New York Economic Club in September 2024 during his re-election campaign.

articles.title: Trump called out Big Oil profits. Here’s how much their refining earnings have surged since
articles.summary: President Donald Trump scolded Big Oil in August, saying ExxonMobil and Chevron were making "too much money based on a shortage," as profits surged in the wake of the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran. Corporate results published this week laid out the windfall oil majors are continuing to get from tight fuel supplies and elevated refining margins amid global conflict.

articles.title: Jim Cramer says it's time to look beyond tech. Here are 4 consumer stocks he likes
articles.summary: Investors looking to diversify beyond the struggling artificial intelligence trade should consider consumer staples stocks, CNBC's Jim Cramer said Friday. Kimberly-Clark shares gained nearly 11% in October, but the stock still trades at less than 15 times earnings, with a 4.7% dividend yield. Shares of Procter & Gamble rallied 11% in October, though Cramer prefers Kimberly-Clark's lower valuation and higher dividend yield.

articles.title: Meta outlook revised downward by S&P on cash flow and capex concerns

articles.title: Treasury Department announces new Series I bond rate of 5.51% for the next six months
articles.summary: Amid the post-pandemic inflation peak, the I bond rate hit a record high of 9.62% in May 2022, and investors poured millions into the government-backed, nearly risk-free asset. As inflation cooled and I bond rates fell, many short-term investors redeemed I bonds. But investors could return as inflation pushes I bond rates back up, experts say.
